span.label: mechanisms
span.term: AUGMENTATION IS AN ASSUMPTION, AND THE PAPER STATES IT: that more information can be extracted from the dataset already held. Everything else follows from whether that is true of a given dataset
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: WHAT AUGMENTATION IS ACTUALLY TEACHING: the invariances a recogniser must survive - viewpoint, lighting, occlusion, background, scale - are baked into the DATA rather than into the architecture
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: SIMULATING BIG DATA RATHER THAN OBTAINING IT: overfitting is not much of a problem when data is abundant, so augmentation gives a limited dataset the characteristics of an abundant one
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an unsafe transformation could be made useful rather than harmful by softening the label, so the model learns uncertainty instead of a falsehood - but building those labels is too costly
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: oversampling works by re-balancing the class distribution so the model is not biased toward answering with the majority class
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: medical imaging is short of data FOR STRUCTURAL REASONS, and the paper names rarity first: `Quotation withheld`. The remaining three reasons it lists - patient privacy, the need for expert labellers, and the cost of the scans - are separated from this clause by a journal running header in the staged text and are not inside this span.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: rotation safety is set by one parameter: small rotations help digit recognition and large ones destroy the label, so the same transform is safe and unsafe at different magnitudes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: cropping and translation differ in what they preserve - cropping shrinks the input, translation keeps the spatial dimensions and pads the vacated space
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: colour transformations trade colour bias for spatial characteristics, which is a gain only where colour is not the distinguishing feature
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a kernel filter can be rebuilt as a convolution layer with the right padding and activation, so the augmentation duplicates what the network already does
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AUGMENTATION CANNOT CREATE A CLASS THAT IS ABSENT: no method surveyed will produce a golden retriever from a dataset of bulldogs. It can lessen biases of lighting, occlusion, scale and background, and it cannot supply missing content
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The stated bias limit in the paper's own words, which bounds every technique it surveys
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The survey covers IMAGE data only, with transfer to other data domains asserted rather than shown
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The taxonomy the survey is organised by does not partition its own subject - warping and oversampling are stated not to be mutually exclusive
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: safety is domain-dependent, which is precisely what makes a generalisable augmentation policy hard
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: there is NO image processing function that cannot flip a label at some distortion magnitude - the strongest form of the claim, stated by the authors
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: constructing refined labels for every unsafe augmentation is computationally expensive, which is why the cheap option is to avoid unsafe transforms
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: many experiments deliberately restrict themselves to a subset of a large dataset in order to SIMULATE a limited-data problem rather than face a real one
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: kernel filters are very close to the internal mechanism of a CNN, which is the argument for making them a layer rather than a dataset operation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: in medical imaging the gap between training and test data is more complex than position and translation, so geometric transformations have limited scope there
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: colour transformations can discard the information the task depends on - darkening may hide the object entirely
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: transformations that may alter the label, such as translation or random cropping, must be checked by hand
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Data Augmentation - A DATA-SPACE SOLUTION, defined by WHERE it intervenes rather than by what it does: every other remedy for overfitting changes the model, and this one changes the dataset
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: data warping - the label is PRESERVED and an existing image is transformed
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: oversampling - a NEW instance is synthesised and added. The paper draws the distinction and then says in the next breath that it does not partition: GAN samples can be stacked with random cropping
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
